mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SCHED_ANALYSIS_LOAD_SOURCE ( ANALYSIS_MODEL_VERSION_ID, RAW_DATA_ID, TRANSFORM_RESULT_ID, STATUS, ATTEMPT_COUNT, LOADED_COUNT, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT ) SELECT #{analysisModelVersionId}, T.RAW_DATA_ID, R.TRANSFORM_RESULT_ID, 'PENDING', 0, 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM SCHED_TRANSFORM_RESULT R INNER JOIN SCHED_TRANSFORM_TASK T ON R.TRANSFORM_TASK_ID = T.TRANSFORM_TASK_ID WHERE R.TRANSFORM_RESULT_ID = #{transformResultId} AND T.TRANSFORM_RULE_VERSION_ID = #{transformRuleVersionId} AND T.STATUS = 'SUCCESS'
